arabic text: BIKHRE PARE HAIN LASHE, KARBALA ME AKE
english translation text: THE BODIES ARE SCATTERED ON THE PLAINS OF KARBALA

arabic text: BIKHRE PARE HAIN LASHE, KARBALA ME AKE,\nZAINAB UJAR GAYI HAI, KARBALA ME AKE
english translation text: THE BODIES ARE SCATTERED ON THE PLAINS OF KARBALA\nBIBI ZAINAB (S.A) HAS LOST ALL HER LOVED ONES ON THE PLAINS OF KARBALA

arabic text: KAISE BHULAYE MADAR ASGHAR KA TIR KHANA\nCHUP CHUP KE RO RAHI HAI JHOOLE SE SAR LAGA KAR
english translation text: HOW CAN THE MOTHER OF ALI ASGHER (A.S) FORGET THE WAY HE WAS SHOT WITH AN ARROW,\nSHE IS CRYING SILENTLY NEAR THE CRADLE OF ALI ASGHER (A.S)

arabic text: HATHO SE DIL KO THAME DORE HAI SHAH RAN KO\nSHAYAD GIRE HAIN AKBAR BARCHI JIGAR PE KHA KE
english translation text: MAM HUSSAIN (A.S.) RAN TO THE BATTLEFIELD WITH HIS HANDS ON HIS HEART,\nIT SEEMS THAT ALI AKBER (A.S) HAS FALLEN TO THE GROUND AFTER BEING HIT BY A SPEAR

arabic text: PAMAL KAR DIYA HAI LASHKAR NE JIME QASIM\nSHAH CHUN RAHE HAIN TUKRE APNI ABA BICHA KE
english translation text: THE ARMY OF THE ENEMY HAS DESTROYED THE BODY OF QASIM (A.S.),\nIMAM HUSSAIN (A.S.) IS GATHERING THE PIECES OF QASIM’S BODY PARTS

arabic text: ZAKHMI HAI KAAN DONO BE HAAL HAI SAKINA\nDARYA SE KAUN LAYE ABBAS KO BULA KE
english translation text: BOTH THE EARS OF SAKINA ARE INJURED AND SHE IS DISTRAUGHT,\nWHO WILL CALL ABBAS (A.S) FROM THE BANKS OF THE RIVER TO HELR HER

arabic text: AB KIYA BACHA HAI ZALIM SAB KUCH TO MIT CHUKKA HAI\nZAINAB YEH KAH RAHI THI KHUTBE UNHE SUNA KAR
english translation text: O OPPRESSOR! THERE IS NOTHING LEFT, YOU HAVE DESTROYED EVERYTHING,\nBIBI ZAINAB (S.A) WAS TELLING THEM IN HER SERMONS
